response: The clustering still lacks a dedicated solar and stellar astrophysics cluster — papers on stellar atmospheres, stellar evolution, stellar rotation, granulation, and solar wind physics are scattered across "Exoplanets and Planetary Science," "Plasma waves magnetic fields," and other clusters and should be consolidated into one stellar/solar cluster. The "Plasma waves magnetic fields" cluster is a problematic catch-all mixing solar wind physics, gamma-ray burst jets, and cosmological covariance methods — these belong in solar/stellar, high-energy, and instrumentation clusters respectively. Additionally, the "Diverse Astronomical Observations Survey" cluster needs to be dissolved, with AGN and CGM papers moving to high-energy or galactic/extragalactic as appropriate, so that every paper lands in one of the six target subject areas rather than a miscellaneous bin.
